message: Thanks for the offer. We can't accept it as written: our payment split is fixed at 50% on receipt with the balance at inspection, and our maximum order size is 5000 units. Here is our counter: 450 per unit, 1000 to 5000 units, 14-day lead time, 20% paid at shipment, a 2-day grace period, then a 2% per day late cut capped at 10%. We don't share pricing limits, but we're glad to work through the terms with you.
